audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, AUD 150K+, early in the decision (Greece chosen or shortlisted, island not yet). The parent paying needs to see legal validity in Australia, where the money goes and who is on the ground. Do not court the bargain hunter: no 'cheap', no 'under $X', no package-deal framing.

payload.search_intent: Informational planning overview: 'what is involved in a Greek destination wedding and where do we start', with a commercial undertone (venues, costs, planner).
payload.angle: The Australian couple's planning overview for Greece, built as the parent of our Greece spokes. Each section answers one decision (where, when, legal, budget, guests, timeline) in enough depth to decide, then hands off to the page that owns the detail. One section shows what a Wedded Wonderland advisor handles that couples never see: ferries and meltemi wind, transfers and steps for older guests, room blocks, payments in EUR.
serp_gaps_to_win: No top-3 result in any market is a full planning overview; page one is hotels, Pinterest pins and hotel lists.
Nobody writes for Australians: DFAT CNI and apostilles, recognition in Australia, Smartraveller, the long-haul flight and connection to the islands, time zones.
Budgets in the SERP are unsourced EUR aggregator figures. We can give a dated, attributed range (our Santorini cost breakdown) with an AUD approximation.
No result covers guest care: older relatives, caldera steps, ferry and wind disruption, a wet-weather plan.
No result gives a month-by-month planning timeline from Australia.

outline.h2: Where in Greece to marry, islands or mainland
outline.answers: Which part of Greece suits our guest count, style and travellers?
must_include: Short cards (50 to 80 words each), not venue lists: Santorini (caldera, small terraces, many caldera venues cap guest lists at about 30 per our cost breakdown), Mykonos (beach and party energy), Crete (estates, space for larger groups, two airports to verify), smaller Cyclades such as Paros and Naxos, the Ionian (Corfu), and the Athens Riviera and Peloponnese (mainland, no ferry).
One line per card on how guests get there (direct international flights vs connection via Athens or ferry), to be verified by research.
Link each card to its spoke: Santorini venues, Mykonos wedding guide, wedding in Crete; Santorini or Mykonos comparison; Greece venues spoke for the rest.
Name venues only through live profiles on our site (Sea View by En Kipo, Rocabella Santorini) if named at all.

outline.h2: When to marry in Greece, month by month
outline.answers: Which months work, and what changes between islands?
must_include: Two or three sentences, not a weather table: shoulder months vs peak summer heat and crowds, wind in the Cyclades, Orthodox Easter and church calendar affecting dates.
Hemisphere note: Greek May to June and September fall in Australian late autumn and early spring; school holidays matter for guests with children.
Link /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-greece for the month-by-month detail. Do not repeat its figures.

outline.h2: The legal route for Australians in brief
outline.answers: Can we marry legally in Greece, and will Australia recognise it?
must_include: Three routes in a short list: civil, Greek Orthodox, symbolic (marry legally in Australia first).
Australians need a Certificate of No Impediment from DFAT; documents need apostilles and certified Greek translations. Cite the Australian Embassy Athens marriages page inline.
Recognition: Smartraveller says an overseas marriage valid where it took place is generally recognised in Australia; it cannot be registered here. Cite Smartraveller inline.
Same-sex civil marriage legal in Greece since 2024; one line and link the same-sex page.
Say requirements must be confirmed for your own passports and with your town hall.
Hand off to /destination-weddings/greece-marriage-licence for the eight-day wait, town hall lists and document table. Do not duplicate it (max 200 words in this section).

outline.h2: What a destination wedding in Greece costs
outline.answers: What budget range should we expect and what drives it?
must_include: Use our Santorini figures exactly as worded on /real-weddings/santorini-wedding-cost-breakdown (read 24 Nov 2026): 'A Santorini wedding typically ranges from €4,000 to over €55,000, depending heavily on guest count'; micro weddings of 20 to 40 guests €18,000 to €30,000; standard weddings of 50 to 80 guests €30,000 to €55,000; luxury 80+ guests €55,000+. Write as EUR, attribute to that page and its date, add an AUD approximation with the conversion date. Nic sign-off.
Say these are Santorini figures; other islands and the mainland differ. Do not invent ranges for other islands.
Name what quotes leave out (VAT, service charges, transport, set-up, extended hire, supplier meals, weather provisions) and that guest flights and accommodation sit outside the wedding budget.
Link greece-wedding-packages for package inclusions. Never describe the page as a real couple's breakdown (its title says so but the body gives general ranges).
No Concierge prices.

outline.h2: Getting guests from Australia to Greece
outline.answers: How do our guests travel, how long do they need, and what paperwork applies?
must_include: Flight reality from Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth: connection hubs and total travel time, then the island leg (domestic flight or ferry). Research to verify current routes; no airline promises.
Entry: Schengen 90-day rule for Australians, the EU Entry/Exit System, ETIAS status. Cite Smartraveller Greece inline.
How many nights to ask guests to commit, a welcome event and a recovery day for jet lag.
Older guests: steps, cobblestones, boat transfers, summer heat.
Link /travel for guest travel and Wonderland Benefits (wording: benefits vary by hotel and program).

outline.h2: What your advisor handles that guests never see
outline.answers: What goes on behind the scenes, and what can we hand over?
must_include: The invisible work, concretely: ferry and wind contingencies, transfer timings, step-free routes and golf carts or cars for older guests, a covered or indoor wet-weather option, room blocks and release dates, deposits and payments in EUR across borders, town-hall correspondence and translations.

Use brand-profile wording: Wedded Wonderland Concierge as advisor and strategic partner; may recommend a partnered planner, or help you move forward confidently without one; one point of contact, wedding and travel under one roof.
Mid-article soft CTA here (one sentence, from cta-library).

outline.h2: A planning timeline from 18 months out
outline.answers: What do we do, and when, when planning from Australia?
must_include: Stages: 18 to 12 months (island, month, guest count, budget, venue hold, advisor); 12 to 9 (save the dates, room block, planner and key vendors); 9 to 6 (CNI application window and apostilles per DFAT timing, translations); 6 to 3 (guest travel, transfers, menus); final month and wedding week (town hall, witnesses, certificate apostille before flying home).
Flag DFAT peak delays around Australian summer holidays (per the licence guide's Smartraveller source).
Link Wonderland Studio for timeline, budget in multiple currencies and RSVPs.

outline.h2: Questions to ask before you book a venue or planner
outline.answers: How do we test a venue or planner from the other side of the world?
must_include: 8 to 10 questions as a list: guest cap per space (not per property), curfew and amplified-music rules, sunset slot, wind and wet-weather alternative, access and steps, what the quote leaves out, deposit schedule and currency, who is on the ground on the day, supplier restrictions, room block terms.
Speaks to the couple's top fears (wrong planner; planning from far away) and the parent's (hidden costs; nobody on the ground).
Link /search?tab=venues&country=Greece to browse our Greece venue profiles (see link note).

outline.answers: Five direct answers for FAQ schema.
must_include: How much does a destination wedding in Greece cost? (Santorini figures as worded, attributed, dated)
Is a wedding in Greece legally recognised in Australia? (Smartraveller)
What is the best month for a wedding in Greece? (link best-time page)
Can we marry legally in Australia and have a symbolic ceremony in Greece?
Do our guests need a visa to attend a wedding in Greece? (Smartraveller, EES, ETIAS status)

Older-guest access and a wet-weather plan (parent fears 3 and 5).

Every price in EUR with source, date and AUD approximation; Nic sign-off.
One proof point at most (800+ weddings or 54 countries), from brand-profile.
